_comment: Who to write to about an objective, keyed by ONS area code. postcodes.io returns codes.ced and codes.admin_ward for a postcode at runtime; these are the same codes. Built by scripts/build_representatives.py from each council's own published directory — no address here is derived from a name pattern, and a councillor whose official address is not published is absent rather than guessed. Re-run after an election.
